rulings.challenge_claim: The stated reason for ending the unit at web:Jer.9.2 is contradicted by the unit's own closing verse, because the third-person accusation placed after the seam already begins inside it; the seam-adjacent parashah evidence is disclosed on only one of the two sides, the mark at oshb:Jer.9.2 = web:Jer.9.3 going unmentioned while the mark at oshb:Jer.8.17 is disclosed; and two prose coordinates inside the numbering zone are left bare of any dual or qualifier.
rulings.grounds: Re-derived from bytes; three legs, and they do not fall together. LEG 1 (real, but narrower than claimed). The accusation is byte-true inside the closing verse: כִּ֤י כֻלָּם֙ מְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים עֲצֶ֖רֶת בֹּגְדִֽים re-collates at byte tier against oshb:Jer.9.1 = web:Jer.9.2, “For they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.” (web:Jer.9.2). But it stands as a subordinate causal clause under the first-person wish frame that opens that same verse, מִֽי יִתְּנֵ֣נִי (byte tier), the frame that also opens oshb:Jer.8.23 = web:Jer.9.1 with מִֽי יִתֵּ֤ן (byte tier); the contiguous interrogative-plus-yiqtol wish family stands in exactly 2 verses book-wide, those two adjacent sites and no other (sweep: 2 verses, MT keys oshb:Jer.8.23 and oshb:Jer.9.1). The verse after the seam is a different thing again: oshb:Jer.9.2 = web:Jer.9.3 opens verse-initially with וַֽיַּדְרְכ֤וּ (byte tier), a third-person main clause carrying no wish frame at all, and closes וְאֹתִ֥י לֹֽא יָדָ֖עוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה (byte tier), where the first person has become Yahweh's own and is sealed by the postpositive divine formula. So the discriminator has to be cut at the speaker-frame level, not at the presence of third-person description: what changes at the cut is who speaks, a tier-1 participant and speaker change, and it falls exactly there. Two byte facts leave that the only warrant available: across oshb:Jer.8.18-oshb:Jer.9.1 there is no speech formula and no postpositive divine formula (sweep: 152 verses carry the koh-amar-YHWH skeleton book-wide, 0 of them in this span, the nearest after it four verses past the seam at oshb:Jer.9.6 = web:Jer.9.7; sweep: 162 verses carry the neum-YHWH skeleton book-wide, 0 of them in this span, the formula standing at oshb:Jer.8.17 immediately before it and at oshb:Jer.9.2 immediately after it). What survives of the challenge is therefore this: the stated warrant names a feature the unit's own closing clause contains, and that straddling accusation goes undisclosed as cross-seam continuity. What does not survive is the word contradicted — the seam is tier-1 grounded on the speaker change and is not disturbed. LEG 2 (refuted on bytes). The two marks are not a symmetric pair and cannot be read as two sides of one disclosure. The setumah at oshb:Jer.8.17 closes the verse immediately preceding the unit, so it is seam-coincident with the front cut. The unit's closing verse, oshb:Jer.9.1 = web:Jer.9.2, carries 0 parashah marks, so there is no back-seam mark to disclose; the setumah at oshb:Jer.9.2 = web:Jer.9.3 closes the verse after the unit and is span-relevant to the unit beginning at web:Jer.9.3, which does disclose it. Inside oshb:Jer.8.18-oshb:Jer.9.1 the single-witness layers are empty: 0 parashah marks, 0 paseq segs, 0 variant notes, so the span-relevant disclosure set is already complete, and the mark cited is corroboration, not a driver (tier-3, single-witness, petuchah and setumah kept distinct; absence is not counterevidence). LEG 3 (real, low, not the breach implied). The two bare coordinates exist and both resolve on the WEB side inside the zone. But the unit carries 3 dual-cited zone pairs, web:Jer.9.3 = oshb:Jer.9.2, oshb:Jer.8.23 = web:Jer.9.1 and oshb:Jer.9.1 = web:Jer.9.2, each arithmetically right on the injective crosswalk, and it clears the zone-disclosure enforcement under a live-arm control check (a control copy with those duals stripped fails on 3 refs; a control copy with 1 dual mis-set fails on its arithmetic), structured references being the object the Tier-0 zone rule governs. The bare prose digits are an ambiguity residue below that threshold, cheap to cure and inconsistent with the dual practice used two sentences earlier, not a Tier-0 failure. FURTHER DEFECT, not raised in the challenge: the rival-alternative sentence weighs 1 rival, the chapter-division rival at web:Jer.8.22, while the live rival at the contested seam is the other one, closing at web:Jer.9.1 = oshb:Jer.8.23 so the wayfarers' lodge wish travels with the indictment its own subordinate clause introduces. That rival is what the bytes make available here, and it goes unweighed.
rulings.remedy: boundary_rationale — replace the closing sentence. State that the unit ends at web:Jer.9.2 = oshb:Jer.9.1 because the first-person wish frame governing oshb:Jer.8.18-oshb:Jer.9.1 stops there and web:Jer.9.3 = oshb:Jer.9.2 opens a verse-initial third-person main clause whose own first person is Yahweh's, closed by the postpositive divine formula (tier-1; splice the pointed run from the source, never re-key it), not because third-person description of the people begins there. In the same sentence disclose that the third-person accusation already stands, subordinated, in the unit's own closing clause and so straddles the seam. TEST (the test that killed the original): read the corrected sentence against the bytes of oshb:Jer.9.1 and oshb:Jer.9.2 side by side — it must name no feature that oshb:Jer.9.1 itself contains, and the straddling accusation must be disclosed; the original fails both arms. strongest_rejected_alternative — re-aim it at the back-seam rival (closing at web:Jer.9.1 = oshb:Jer.8.23, the wayfarers' lodge wish going with the indictment it introduces), within the existing one-sentence limit. TEST: the rival named must be the one the bytes make live at the contested seam, not the chapter-division rival at web:Jer.8.22. boundary_rationale and device_notes — give the two bare in-zone coordinates their qualifier: web:Jer.9.3 = oshb:Jer.9.2 in the rationale, web:Jer.9.2 = oshb:Jer.9.1 in the device note. TEST: no coordinate touching WEB ch 9 or MT 8:23 / MT ch 9 stands in any field without a witness prefix or dual, and each dual's arithmetic checks on the crosswalk. NO RESPAN IS ORDERED — web:Jer.8.18-web:Jer.9.2 stands on this evidence; any boundary change is a proposal requiring explicit adoption, never author work. device_notes keeps its existing setumah disclosure at oshb:Jer.8.17 unchanged (correct and seam-coincident) and adds nothing about oshb:Jer.9.2, which lies outside this span. observed_substrate_signals needs no edit unless the corrected warrant is recorded as a new signal key, in which case it changes in the same edit.
